dialogue.origin: こんにちは相談役をさせていただきますよろしくお願いします
dialogue.content: Hello, I'll be playing the role of the client. It's a pleasure to meet you.

dialogue.origin: こんにちは。相談員役をさせていただきます。よろしくお願いいたします。はじめに年齢、性別、相談内容を教えてください。
dialogue.content: Hello. I'll be playing the role of the counselor. It's a pleasure to meet you as well. To begin, could you please tell me your age, gender, and the nature of your concern?

dialogue.origin: 名前はハンバーグです40代女性です主人との金銭感覚の違いに不安があります
dialogue.content: My name is Hamburg. I'm a woman in my 40s. I'm anxious about the differences in financial sense between my husband and me.

dialogue.origin: ハンバーグさん、ご相談ありがとうございます。お相手さんとの金銭感覚の違いに不安があるのですね。確かに不安になりますよね。具体的にはどのような時に不安を感じますか？
dialogue.content: Thank you for sharing that, Ms. Hamburg. You're feeling anxious about the differences in financial sense with your husband. That's certainly unsettling. Could you tell me more specifically about the situations in which you feel this anxiety?

dialogue.origin: 今朝も久しぶりに子どもの前でケンカになり最悪でした
dialogue.content: This morning, for the first time in a while, we had a fight in front of our child, and it was awful.

dialogue.origin: とにかく買い物が好きで、毎日Amazonから品物が届きます、
dialogue.content: He just loves to shop, and packages from Amazon arrive every day.

dialogue.origin: 本やCD、雑貨など子どものためだと言うのですが、とにかくお金を使うのが好きなので老後が心配です
dialogue.content: He says things like books, CDs, and miscellaneous items are for our child, but he just loves spending money, so I'm worried about our retirement.

dialogue.origin: なるほど。Amazonが来るたびに浪費を感じて心配になりますよね。お相手さんとは今後の家計のことをお話ししたりしたことはありますか？
dialogue.content: I see. Every time an Amazon package arrives, it feels like wasteful spending and makes you worry, doesn't it? Have you ever talked with your husband about your household finances going forward?

dialogue.origin: わたしは主婦なのでお金の管理の主導権が主人にありますその為に収支の詳細がわかりません、聞いてもあまり詳しくは教えてくれません、
dialogue.content: Since I'm a homemaker, my husband has control over our finances. Because of that, I don't know the details of our income and expenses, and even when I ask, he doesn't tell me much.

dialogue.origin: そんな中で最近クレジットカードでリボ払いがかさみ、限度額がいっぱいだと知って青ざめました、
dialogue.content: In the midst of that, I recently found out the revolving payments on the credit card have piled up and the card is maxed out. I was horrified.

dialogue.origin: 確かに主導権を握られると把握しづらくなりますよね。限度額がいっぱいは緊張が走りますね。ちなみに今朝はどのような喧嘩をしたのですか？
dialogue.content: I can see how it would be difficult to grasp the situation when he's the one in control. Reaching the credit limit must be nerve-wracking. By the way, what was the argument about this morning?

dialogue.origin: 主人が毎日する外食についてです、
dialogue.content: It was about my husband eating out every day.

dialogue.origin: 昼とたまに夜はひとりで呑むのでしが、毎日写メを送ってくるので気になります、
dialogue.content: He eats lunch out, and sometimes goes for drinks by himself at night. What bothers me is that he sends me pictures of it every day.

dialogue.origin: もちろんそんなに高額ではないのですが、そこもわたしの感覚とはズレています
dialogue.content: Of course, it's not that expensive, but even that is out of sync with my financial sense.

dialogue.origin: なるほど。毎日の外食も食費がどんどん出ていきますから不安も重なりますよね。毎日写メを送ってくるというのはどのような写メですか？
dialogue.content: I see. Eating out every day can really add to your food expenses, so I can understand how that would add to your anxiety. What kind of pictures does he send you every day?

dialogue.origin: 食べる食事の写メをLINEで送ってきます、頼んではないのですが、、普段はもう好きにさせているのですが、来月の生活費が満額渡せないと言われ話題に出したところキレられました
dialogue.content: He sends me pictures of the food he's eating on LINE. It's not like I ask him to... I usually just let him do as he pleases, but when he told me he couldn't give me the full amount for next month's living expenses, I brought it up and he snapped at me.

dialogue.origin: 主人的にはそのLINEのやりとりはコミュニケーションのつもりのようです、
dialogue.content: It seems that from my husband's perspective, those LINE exchanges are his way of communicating.

dialogue.origin: なるほど。食事の写メですね。写メだけでなく「今日はこれを食べたよ」みたいなメッセージも来るのですか？
dialogue.content: I see. Pictures of his meals. Does he also send messages like, "This is what I ate today," not just the photos?

dialogue.origin: はい、その後の予定とかも、
dialogue.content: Yes, and his plans for after, things like that.

dialogue.origin: そうなのですね。普段はお相手さんとの仲は良いのですか？
dialogue.content: I see. Is your relationship with your husband generally good?

dialogue.origin: まぁ普通だと思います、
dialogue.content: Well, I think it's pretty normal.

dialogue.origin: 会話もスキンシップもあります
dialogue.content: We talk and we're physically affectionate.

dialogue.origin: なるほど。金銭の話になるとお相手さんが感情的になるという感じですか？
dialogue.content: I see. So it seems like your husband gets emotional when the topic of money comes up?

dialogue.origin: はい、その通りです！
dialogue.content: Yes, that's exactly right!

dialogue.origin: 今朝もお金の細かいことを言うなとキレられました、
dialogue.content: This morning he snapped at me again, telling me not to nitpick about money.

dialogue.origin: 主人がキレるスイッチといった感じです
dialogue.content: It's like a switch that makes my husband snap.

dialogue.origin: わたしも毎日言ったりはしません、
dialogue.content: I don't bring it up every day, either.

dialogue.origin: 約束が果たされないと不愉快でつい言ってしまいます、
dialogue.content: But when promises aren't kept, I get upset and can't help but say something.

dialogue.origin: なるほど。そうなのですね。金銭の話をすると怒りに触れてしまうという感じですね。なぜお相手さんはそこにスイッチができてしまったと思いますか？
dialogue.content: I see. So, talking about money seems to touch a nerve with him. Why do you think he developed that trigger?

dialogue.origin: 事業をやっているので資金繰りがつらくなる時があるからだと思います
dialogue.content: I think it's because he runs a business and there are times when cash flow gets tight.

dialogue.origin: プラスどんぶり勘定なので、
dialogue.content: Plus, he's very lax with his accounting.

dialogue.origin: なるほど。事業が上手くいかなかったり、資金に不安がでてきてお相手さんもイライラしてしまうといった感じですかね。なるほど。さらにどんぶり勘定なのですね。不安は増しますよね。今までに真剣にお相手さんと今後の家計についてお話しされたことはありますか？
dialogue.content: I see. So, perhaps when the business isn't going well or he's worried about funds, he gets irritable. I understand. And on top of that, he has a lax approach to finances. That must increase your anxiety. Have you ever had a serious talk with your husband about your future household finances?

dialogue.origin: あります、老後に向けてとりあえず借財をなるべく少なくしてほしいと伝えあります
dialogue.content: Yes, I have. I've told him that, looking toward our retirement, I'd like him to reduce our debt as much as possible for now.

dialogue.origin: 保険の見直しや不用品の処分など、
dialogue.content: Things like reviewing our insurance policies and getting rid of things we don't need.

dialogue.origin: 主人はわたしより10歳上なので、
dialogue.content: My husband is 10 years older than me,

dialogue.origin: 老後もそんなに遠いはなしではなくて、
dialogue.content: so retirement isn't that far off,

dialogue.origin: ちゃんと考えると、わたしは不安になります
dialogue.content: and when I really think about it, I get anxious.

dialogue.origin: なるほど。そうですよね。不安になりますよね。お相手さんからはどのような返事だったのですか？
dialogue.content: I see. That's understandable; it would make anyone anxious. What was his response?

dialogue.origin: わかったと言ってくれました、そして主人なりに行動しているのでしょう、
dialogue.content: He said he understood, and I suppose he's taking action in his own way.

dialogue.origin: その行動の結果が見えてこない、、、という感じですかね。
dialogue.content: But you're not seeing the results of those actions... is that how it feels?

dialogue.origin: そうなんです、なにせ詳細を見せてくれませんから、
dialogue.content: Exactly. After all, he won't show me the details.

dialogue.origin: なるほど。そのお話をされたのは自宅でされましたか？
dialogue.content: I see. Did you have that conversation at home?

dialogue.origin: 信じて見守るほかないのでしょう
dialogue.content: I suppose I have no choice but to trust him and wait and see.

dialogue.origin: そうわかっていても子どもの習い事を減らせ、とか言われるとかなり矛盾を感じて腹が立ちます
dialogue.content: Even though I know that, when he tells me to cut back on our child's lessons and activities, it feels so contradictory that it makes me angry.

dialogue.origin: 優先順位も違うのだなとガッカリもします
dialogue.content: It also disappoints me to realize our priorities are different.

dialogue.origin: いつも自宅か車の中です
dialogue.content: It's always at home or in the car.

dialogue.origin: そして子どもの前で始めるのでそれも本当にイヤです
dialogue.content: And he starts these arguments in front of our child, which I really hate.

dialogue.origin: 故意ではないと思いますがやめてくれない
dialogue.content: I don't think he does it on purpose, but he won't stop.

dialogue.origin: そうなのですね。確かに子供にとってもいやですよね。ちなみに真剣な話し合いの時にハンバーグさんの心配している、不安な気持ちはお相手さんにお伝えしたのですか？
dialogue.content: I see. That must be unpleasant for your child as well. By the way, during your serious discussions, did you convey your worries and anxious feelings to your husband?

dialogue.origin: ちゃんと言葉にして伝えています、
dialogue.content: Yes, I've told him clearly in my own words.

dialogue.origin: 不安だから詳細を見て一緒に具合的に計画を立てたいと、
dialogue.content: I tell him that because I'm anxious, I want to see the details so we can make a concrete plan together.

dialogue.origin: でも見せたくないようです、それがまた不安をあおります、、
dialogue.content: But it seems he doesn't want to show me, and that just fuels my anxiety.

dialogue.origin: そうなのですね。見せたくない理由はおっしゃっていましたか？
dialogue.content: I see. Did he give a reason for not wanting to show you?

dialogue.origin: 知られたくないこともあるだろ？
dialogue.content: "There are things I don't want you to know, right?"

dialogue.origin: といいます
dialogue.content: is what he says.

dialogue.origin: そうなのですね。最近お相手さんとお二人でデートはされましたか？
dialogue.content: I see. Have you and your husband gone on a date recently, just the two of you?

dialogue.origin: いいえ、まだ子どもが小学生なのでだいたい家族で出掛けます
dialogue.content: No, our child is still in elementary school, so we usually go out as a family.

dialogue.origin: なるほど。一回お子さんもいない場で、家や車の中でなく、外出して今のハンバーグさんのお気持ちをお話ししてみるのもいいのかなと思いました。家の中や車の中だとやはり気持ちが緩んでしまって、感情的になりやすい環境でもありますし、外のような気が入る場であれば相手のことを気遣う心になりやすくなります。
dialogue.content: I see. I was thinking it might be a good idea to try talking about your current feelings somewhere outside, without your child present—not at home or in the car. At home or in the car, it's easy to let your guard down and become emotional. But in a more public setting, people tend to be more considerate of each other.

dialogue.origin: そうですね、老後についてお金だけではなく、お互いのビジョンをゆっくり話していけたらいいなと思います
dialogue.content: You're right. I think it would be good if we could take our time to talk not only about money for retirement but also about our shared vision for the future.

dialogue.origin: 一回デートに誘ってお二人で楽しいことをして、ハンバーグさんのお気持ちだけでもお伝えすると、お相手さんも心を開いてお話ししていただけるのかなと、、、
dialogue.content: Perhaps if you invite him on a date, do something fun together, and then share just your feelings, he might open up and talk to you as well...

dialogue.origin: 確かに、不安発信ばかりになっていたかもしれません、今日はお話し聴いていただきありがとうございました
dialogue.content: That's true, I may have been communicating only from a place of anxiety. Thank you for listening to me today.

dialogue.origin: 老後、老後と言われるのもイヤかも、と思いました
dialogue.content: I also realized he might hate hearing me go on and on about 'retirement, retirement'.

dialogue.origin: もう少しゆっくり、
dialogue.content: A little more slowly...

dialogue.origin: そしてまず今という時間を大切に共有できたらいいなと思いました
dialogue.content: and I thought it would be good if we could first cherish and share the present moment together.

dialogue.origin: いえいえ。こちらこそありがとうございました。でも私なら今後のことも考えてくれているのだと嬉しい気持ちになりますよ。そうですね。ゆっくりお互いのことを共有できると前に進めると思います。
dialogue.content: Not at all. Thank you as well. But if it were me, I would be happy to know you're thinking about our future. Yes, I think you can move forward if you can slowly share with each other.

dialogue.origin: お二人の今後のこと応援しております。すみません。時間になってしまいました。ご相談は大丈夫でしょうか？まだお話し足りないことありましたら、またお話しお聞かせください。
dialogue.content: I’m rooting for the two of you and your future together. I’m sorry, but our time is up. Is this a good place to stop? If there’s more you’d like to talk about, please feel free to reach out again.

dialogue.origin: いえいえ、誰にも話せずにいたのでスッキリ、前向きになれました！ありがとうございました！
dialogue.content: Not at all. I couldn't talk to anyone about this, so I feel so relieved and more positive now! Thank you so much!

dialogue.origin: よかったです！また何かありましたら、お話しください。では、本日の相談を終わらせていただきます。ありがとうございました。
dialogue.content: I’m glad to hear that! If anything else comes up, please feel free to talk with me again. We’ll wrap up today’s session here. Thank you.

dialogue.origin: お疲れ様でした。
dialogue.content: Thank you for your time.

dialogue.origin: ありがとうございます。お疲れ様でした。
dialogue.content: Thank you. Take care.

topic.sub: 金銭感覚の不一致によるコミュニケーション問題
